title: Parabolic-preserving deformations of cusped hyperbolic lattices
summary: We study deformations of non-cocompact lattices of ${\rm SO}(n,1)$ into ${\rm SU}(n,1)$ and ${\rm SO}(n+1,1)$. A necessary condition for these deformations to remain discrete and faithful (when $n \geqslant 3$) is for the parabolic subgroups to remain parabolic and discrete; we call such representations \emph{strongly parabolic-preserving}. We show that the figure-eight knot group admits a one-parameter family of Zariski-dense parabolic-preserving deformations into ${\rm SU}(3,1)$, with further deformations into ${\rm SU}(2,2)$.
